answer: Treat reputation like an umber patina: it only darkens with age and real work. A sybil farm can mint a thousand fresh keys, but each starts pale, weighted near zero in grading panels and rewards. Weight grows only from attestations by already-aged peers, capped per epoch, so new keys vouching for each other form an isolated oasis the trust graph never flows into. A key that stops working decays into a relic with no voting weight, so stockpiled or bought accounts lose value too.
